name: Aiden Zhang
intro: Hey, I'm Aiden, a first-year Computer Engineering student at the University of Waterloo. I'm interested in building software, firmware, and hardware, from full-stack applications and AI/ML to computer vision, robotics, and embedded systems. I'm currently on the WARG Autonomy subteam and the UW Formula Electric firmware subteam. I'm looking for a Summer 2027 co-op where I can contribute, learn from others, and keep building.
